characterization_status: Retired and pushed in 5831a036bd6b6c4aad346a5442eb6df9280e0bb7. Current corpus: 177 pristine cases, 66 approved sparse corrected overlays, and 177 effective cases across 13 operations. Loom alpha.15 is the implementation baseline. JSON request bodies are UTF-8 bytes regardless of charset labels; labels do not select a decoder, and no transcoding occurs. Malformed standard JSON MIME parameters return 415 before nil/empty-body success. Invalid UTF-8 bytes and incomplete trailing UTF-8 return 400 before domain effects. Historical: the earlier 164-case tree passed full proof and 241 proxy comparisons before review found the malformed-byte activity gap. Final R7 proof passed all ten stages in 392 seconds, the production-proxy differential passed 241/241, and four fresh runtime review scopes were CLEAN. Authenticated UI flows passed; final Logal had 0 logs and 0 failed HTTP spans, and dev:check-logs passed. Native hover display is unverified. See project-lifecycle-proof-ledger.md for release evidence and diagnostic limitations.
